messages:
asha_ae: Quick heads-up — Zenith wants a Private POC with BYOK and HSM-backed keys for TLS and SSH admin access. What exact artifacts do we need to hand off and any gotchas? cc @tom_se @leah_sre

 tom_se: For onboarding we'll need: their KMS/HSM type (Thales/Luna, Gemalto, AWS KMS, Azure KV), the public wrapping/signing key or CA bundle, and the intended trust model (they sign our CSR vs we generate and they import wrapped key). Also need network ingress details and service-account contact.

 leah_sre: Ops notes: prefer they sign our CSR if they want full custody. If not, we can generate keypair and they import private key wrapped by their public wrapping key (PKCS#11 flow). Also need: VPC peering info, bastion IPs, list of admin principals for SSH CA, and whether cert rotation should be automatic.

 marco_security: Security checklist quick: 1) KMS key usage/policy (sign/encrypt only) 2) HSM key import policy + wrapping algorithm (RSA-OAEP/ECIES) 3) Audit/event retention for key ops 4) Attestation method (TPM/Nitro/Azure Attestation) 5) Cert rotation SLA. If they require attestation we need their attestation token.

 asha_ae: They said Thales Luna on-prem + internal PKI for TLS. They want automated cert rotation and an initial manual bootstrap. Also asked whether we can do a one-time handoff for admin SSH CA pub key.

 tom_se: Flow we recommend: 1) Exchange admin SSH CA public key (we can trust theirs or they trust ours — pick one). 2) We generate a CSR on our side, they sign with their Luna and return cert chain. 3) For key import scenario, they provide wrapping public key and we perform keywrap for import. Example CSR gen (ops will use this):

 ```
 openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -out redwood-zenith.key -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:3072
 openssl req -new -key redwood-zenith.key -subj "/CN=redwood-zenith/O=Zenith Prod/OU=infra" -out redwood-zenith.csr
 ```

 leah_sre: Additional ops details: we'll create a vault path secret/private/zenith/{tls,ssh-ca,wrapping-key-meta}. For the SSH CA we only deliver the public key. Decide trust model: if they sign user keys, they keep full control; if we sign, we need their list of principals and a signed attestation that our signing key is accepted. Also need their admin contact for the Thales console.

 asha_ae: Pricing/POC note: Zenith asked for dedicated pool estimate with HSM add-on. They want to size for inference throughput ~150 tps. @tom_se any quick HW rec?

 tom_se: For a short POC I'd recommend 2x A10g nodes with reserved burst; if we need lower latency and higher perf then 1x H100. I'll send a rough cost figure offline to avoid clogging thread.

 marco_security: One previous blocker: client ops couldn't expose an HSM signing endpoint for remote CSR signing. If they can't sign remotely, confirm they support key wrapping/import via PKCS#11 or an export-wrapped method. Ask them: can you provide a wrapping public key and documentation for import?

 deploy-bot: Terraform: plan for zenith-private-poc completed — plan: 6 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy.

 asha_ae: Great — next actions: Tom will draft artifact checklist + CSR steps, Leah will prepare the env template + vault paths, Marco will attach the HSM/security questionnaire snippet for key policies. I'll schedule the key-exchange call with their ops. :thumbsup:
